# geopt

This is a package centered around Portuguese spatial data. The main
features are:

- **Official downloads**: full-resolution CAOP, server-side queries
  against the DGT OGC API, and INE census geographies (BGRI subsecções
  and secções, 1 km grid).
- A **join layer**: match data by code or by name, without fighting
  accents, duplicate names or codes from older vintages.
- **Ready-to-map boundaries**: pre-simplified sf objects from freguesia
  up to NUTS 1, plus health boundaries, with Açores and Madeira as
  optional insets.
- **Vintages**: codes and names for four freguesia maps (2001, 2011,
  2013 and 2025), with boundaries for the 2013 and 2025 ones, plus three
  NUTS revisions and the health geography before and after the 2024
  reform. Crosswalks convert freguesia data between maps. Each of these
  changes on its own schedule, so each has its own vintage argument.

## Example maps

![Municipality and ULS maps produced with
plot_pt()](reference/figures/README-overview-maps-1.png)

## Installation

``` r

# From CRAN
install.packages("geopt")

# From GitHub
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("c-matos/geopt")
```

## A map in one line

``` r

library(geopt)

# Custom data
df <- data.frame(
  concelho = c("PORTO", "Lisboa", "golega", "Faro", "Lagoa (RAA)", "Calheta (RAM)"),
  score = c(10, 25, 15, 8, 18, 12)
)

# Plot a map
plot_pt(df, value = "score", by = c(municipio = "concelho"))
#> get_map: 302 boundaries have no data row (NA fill).
```

![](reference/figures/README-one-line-map-1.png)

- Names were matched with the bundled spatial data, ignoring accents and
  case. The qualifiers picked the right unit: Lagoa (RAA) is the one in
  the Açores, not Faro’s, and Calheta (RAM) the one in Madeira, not São
  Jorge’s.
- The archipelagos are there as insets
- Return value is a plain ggplot you can customise.

Add `renderer = "echarts"` for an interactive htmlwidget instead.

``` r

plot_pt(df, value = "score", by = c(municipio = "concelho"), renderer = "echarts")
```

## Learn more

Start with
[`vignette("geopt")`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/articles/geopt.html),
then pick the guide for the task at hand:

- **Change the island layout**, draw frames around the islands, or use
  tmap or echarts4r instead of ggplot2:
  [`vignette("map-compositions")`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/articles/map-compositions.html)
- **Get your data onto the map** by code or by name, including ambiguous
  and misspelled names:
  [`vignette("joining-data")`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/articles/joining-data.html)
- **Map ULS, regiões de saúde or ACES**:
  [`vignette("health-geographies")`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/articles/health-geographies.html)
- **Work with older boundaries**, or convert freguesia data across
  reorganizations:
  [`vignette("vintages")`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/articles/vintages.html)
- **Download full-resolution CAOP**, INE census data, or query DGT’s
  online service:
  [`vignette("downloading-data")`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/articles/downloading-data.html)

Curious how it works? [The website](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/)
has articles on how the bundled data is built and how name matching
works.

## Data sources

- **Administrative boundaries**: [CAOP — Carta Administrativa Oficial de
  Portugal](https://www.dgterritorio.gov.pt/cartografia/cartografia-tematica/caop),
  Direção-Geral do Território (DGT).
- **Census geographies**: [BGRI and the 1 km
  grid](https://mapas.ine.pt/download/index2021.phtml), Instituto
  Nacional de Estatística (INE). Downloaded on demand by
  [`get_censos()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/get_censos.md),
  not bundled.
- **NUTS and health geographies**: see
  [`?pt_nuts_codes`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_nuts_codes.md)
  and
  [`?pt_health_codes`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_health_codes.md).

geopt is not affiliated with DGT or INE.

## AI disclosure

AI was used in the development of this package. Claude (Anthropic),
specifically Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and Opus 5.5, assisted with writing
code, tests and documentation.

# Package index

## Make a map

Composed maps of Portugal (mainland + island insets) and one-liner
choropleths.

- [`plot_pt()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/plot_pt.md) :
  Quick map of Portugal
- [`get_map()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/get_map.md) :
  Get a composed map of Portugal

## Island layout

How the Açores and Madeira are shown, and helpers for drawing the frames
and island labels with echarts4r.

- [`island_layout()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/island_layout.md)
  : Lay out the islands
- [`frame_data_echarts()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/frame_data_echarts.md)
  : Build echarts frame styling data
- [`box_labels_echarts()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/box_labels_echarts.md)
  : Add labels to an echarts map

## Join and match

Getting custom data onto official units.

- [`pt_join()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_join.md) :
  Add official codes and administrative context to a data frame
- [`pt_match()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_match.md)
  : Match place names to official codes
- [`pt_match_report()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_match_report.md)
  : Retrieve the match report from a pt_match result
- [`pt_normalize()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_normalize.md)
  : Normalize Portuguese place names for matching
- [`pt_pad_code()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_pad_code.md)
  : Restore leading zeros in administrative codes

## Vintages

Converting freguesia-level data between boundary vintages.

- [`pt_crosswalk()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_crosswalk.md)
  : Correspondence between two administrative vintages
- [`pt_recode()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_recode.md)
  : Convert freguesia-level data between code vintages

## Download client

Full-resolution CAOP downloads, INE census geographies, and the DGT OGC
API.

- [`GeoClient`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/GeoClient.md)
  : GeoClient
- [`get_censos()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/get_censos.md)
  : Get INE census geographies (BGRI, secções, GRID)

## Data

Bundled boundaries and lookup tables.

- [`pt_freguesias`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_municipios`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_distritos`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_nuts1`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_nuts2`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_nuts3`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_uls`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_reg_saude`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_aces`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_uls_municipio`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  [`pt_aces_municipio`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/boundaries.md)
  : Simplified Portuguese administrative boundaries
- [`pt_censos_vars`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_censos_vars.md)
  : Census variables available from get_censos()
- [`pt_registry`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_registry.md)
  : Portuguese administrative units, every vintage
- [`pt_lookup()`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_lookup.md)
  : Administrative, NUTS and health codes for one choice of each vintage
- [`pt_health_codes`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_health_codes.md)
  : Health geography of Portuguese freguesias, both vintages
- [`pt_nuts_codes`](https://c-matos.github.io/geopt/reference/pt_nuts_codes.md)
  : NUTS classification of Portuguese municípios, every revision
